title: 第14章 夜明珠第15章 我更希望你叫我苏三

第一卷 重生归来 第十四章 夜明珠
“我把四合院的电话号码写给你吧，有机会了就给我打电话。”说着拿了一张纸，写下了电话号码。
离开陶泽西的住所，苏芮并没有坐车回四合院，而是在青木小县城里逛了起来。
重生没几天，苏芮还没好好的感受这个时代。不过只能让她失望了，因为在街上根本就看不到什么复古的“潮人”，这里毕竟不是东部，信息还没那么发达，人们也没那么容易接受新的事物。而且还有很多少数民族。只不过那满街的自行车和古老的公交车还真是这个时代的标志。
街道两旁有很多摆摊的，大多是小吃还有水果。一个摊位吸引住了苏芮的目光。那个摊位的位置很偏僻，而且也很简陋，只是用一个破布铺在地上，布上面摆着一些瓷器，还有一些陶俑。很明显，这是一个卖古董的。
其实在这个时候古玩这个行当已经兴起，不过在青木这个小县城里估计没几个人有
苏芮能发现这个地摊是因为她看到整个摊位泛着紫光。估计是有什么宝贝，所以她肯定要过去看看的。
那个小贩看到只是一个小姑娘，不耐烦的说“一边玩去，这不是买玩具的地方，别打扰老子做生意。”
苏芮发现的这个摊贩已经在这摆了好几天了，不过问的多，买的就一个都没有了。这时候见到一个小女生过来，认定她不会买，所以也很不客气。
苏芮没有理会那个小贩，径自蹲下来。刚才离得有些远，苏芮现在才发现整个摊位上只有一个黑漆漆的盒子是泛着浓郁的紫光的，还有两个玉佩，也是泛着紫光的不过和盒子一比那就差远了。苏芮暗自运功，紫金色的气体从她的左胸部的纹身一路向上，到达苏芮的眼睛。苏芮立马就看到了这个盒子的历史，原来真正的宝贝不是这个木盒子，这个木盒子中有一个暗格，暗格中藏着的正是慈禧太后凤冠上的九颗夜明珠中的四颗。
当年外国人入侵京城，慈禧太后不准许人民反击侵略者，而是从凤冠上去下四颗要送给外国人，求他们退出京城。但是当时的大太监李莲英不在身边，所以她就派身边的一个宫女带着夜明珠去西门宾馆交给李莲英的人，但是没想到那个宫女并没有把夜明珠送到李莲英手中，而是带着夜明珠逃了。那个宫女将夜明珠藏在了一个木盒中的暗格里，带着木盒一路逃到了西省，安定了下来。然后又在媒婆的撮合下嫁给了一个鳏夫，为他生了一个儿子，直到她去世，这个木盒就到了他儿子手中，但是她儿子不知道这盒子里有宝贝啊，就当废品一样买给了小贩。
苏芮看到了这段历史，心中可是乐开了花啊，夜明珠可是无价之宝，更何况这里面有四颗啊。
不过苏芮面上什么都没有显露，而是在摊位上挑挑拣拣，随后指着一个泛着弱弱的紫光的玉佩问小贩“大哥这个怎么卖啊？”眨眨眼睛，卖萌又不花钱。
小贩看着这有生意上门了，马上笑盈盈的，变脸的速度还真快。
“哎呦，小妹你好眼力啊，这个是我从西安乡下一个大户人家收来的，这是人家祖传的宝贝，他们家祖上出过两个大官，这个就是知府大人曾经佩戴的。你要是喜欢啊，我就给你一个实心价，三千怎么样，这可是明朝的东西，三千我也就赚个跑腿钱。”
“明朝的？大哥你可别骗我啊，我就是觉得这个寓意挺好，马上封侯。”苏芮貌似天真的说。
苏芮没放下这个玉佩，而是又拿起了来旁边的那一个桃心形的玉佩。
“这两个玉佩我都要了，大哥你开个价吧。”
“你可不能看我小就骗我哦，小心我让人揍你。”苏芮宠她眨眨眼睛。
不知为什么，小贩看着天真表情的苏芮感觉有点冷，一定是错觉，一定是。安慰下自己，小贩开口道。

“既然小妹你真的想要，两个玉佩就给我五千块钱吧，我看咱俩也挺有缘的。”
“五千块钱有点贵吧，我又不知道这两个是不是真的。一千块钱，两个都卖给我。”
一听苏芮还了这么多价，小贩赶紧开口。
“一千可不行，最少也得这个数。”小贩伸出四个手指头。
苏芮淡定的摆弄那个玉佩。
“那就一千五，不能再多了，再多我妈妈会骂我的。”
“一千五还不够我收时候的价格呐，要不你再加点，两千，我就当交个朋友了。”小贩咬牙，一副我大出血了的样子。
“两千就两千，不过你把这个盒子给我当搭头吧，我奶奶以前有一个这样的盒子，不过坏了，正好送给她。”苏芮笑眯眯的看着小贩。
“好，没问题。”
小贩看那个盒子也不是什么值钱的，故作心痛的答应了。
不过他心里却正在偷笑，这是谁家败家小孩，这两个玉佩他收上来也就几十块钱，一下就赚了一千多。在心里琢磨着，要是多来几个这样的不懂事的小孩，他就发啦。
不过苏芮身上可没这么多钱。只能让小贩跟着她去找公共电话亭去打电话，让杜言给她送钱，谁让他是她师傅的秘书呐，不用白不用嘛。
很快，杜言就来了，将苏芮吩咐让带的两千块钱交给小贩，就见苏芮抱起了那个盒子。
“你拿那两个玉佩。”留下一句话，苏芮就率先朝汽车那走去。
杜言手里拿着两个玉佩，而苏芮怀里抱着那个木盒，好像抱着一个瓷娃娃。
杜言看着苏芮小心翼翼的样子，立马就明白了，看来这个盒子才是苏芮想要的，这两个玉佩不过只是幌子而已，但是他没看出那个盒子有什么特别啊。
当小贩看到一个开着小卧车，穿着一身西装的男人冲着苏芮弯腰叫大小姐的时候，那真是后悔啊，后悔没有多要点钱。不过他也没办法反悔了，为啥？没看到车里那个司机膀大腰圆的嘛。只能肉疼的拿了两千块钱走了。
苏芮没让杜言送她到四合院，只让他将她放在村口。
“那两个玉佩就送你了。”说罢，苏芮便抱着盒子下车了。
苏芮回四合院的路上恰好遇到了做完农活回家的李二婶和李二叔。李二叔李成的爷爷与李福的爷爷是兄弟，他们两个也算没出五服的兄弟，但是李福为人自私又贪婪，王春花又是个爱处处占便宜的泼妇，为人正直的李成自然看不惯他们，李二婶为人比较爽利，苏芮的母亲又是她家二儿子的语文老师，所以平时和苏芮家还比较亲近。

这会她看到苏芮，马上就想到了她那双双过世的父母，眼中露出怜悯。心里感叹，还好十四岁了，若是在小一点可怎么办哟，听说被后山那个老头收养了，但也肯定是寄人篱下的，哪有自己亲爹妈好哟。不过总算是比李福他家强。别以为谁都不知道李福的好打算，死了爸妈的孤女也算计，活该进监狱。越想越觉得苏芮可怜。李二婶，放下农具，说道。
“芮芮啊，如今你爸妈去了，我们也帮不上什么大忙，也就是能帮着干点活，你爸妈下葬的时候有什么事就来知会一声啊，我跟你二叔都去帮忙。”
李成犹豫了一下，也开口说“今天中午我回家的时候，看见王春花在你家门口那转悠呐，你说你家也挺偏的，她去那干嘛？你还是注意点吧，别少了什么东西都不知道，你说她家当家的都进去了还不老实…”
苏芮看到两人眼中的真诚，脸色变得柔和起来。
“二婶不用担心我，我被我师父收养了，现在住在他家，家里已经没有什么重要的东西了，我父母的遗物已经被我拿走了，那里只有一些生活用品。”
苏芮顿了一下，看向东方。
“我不打算将父母葬在这里，落叶归根，他们离开家太久了，也该回去了。”
李二婶听她这么说觉得很惊讶，但又觉得在情理之中，毕竟他们的故乡不在这。不过不是说两人都失忆了么？不过她也没有问出来。而是笑了笑。
“既然你打算好了，那就算了，不过有什么忙就跟婶子提，能帮的我们一定帮。”
“那先谢谢二婶了。”
告别李二婶他们，苏芮静静的看了会夕阳。在心中默默的告诉自己，我已经重生了，不会再重蹈覆辙。那些欠我的我一定要亲手讨过来！
伴着夕阳的下落，炊烟袅袅，苏芮轻快的回到四合院，还未给师傅做饭呢。

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 14: Night Pearl
"I'll write you the phone number of the courtyard. If you have a chance, call me." He took a piece of paper and wrote down the phone number.
After leaving Tao Zexi's residence, Su Rui did not take the car back to the courtyard, but walked around the small town of Qingmu.
A few days after her rebirth, Su Rui still had not fully experienced this era. But she can only be disappointed, because there are no retro "hipsters" on the street. After all, this is not the east, information is not so developed, and people are not so easy to accept new things. And there are many ethnic minorities. But the bicycles and ancient buses that fill the streets are really signs of this era.
There are many stalls on both sides of the street, mostly selling snacks and fruits. A stall caught Su Rui's attention. The stall was in a remote location and was very simple. It was just a rag spread on the ground, with some porcelain and some pottery figurines placed on the cloth. It was obvious that this was an antique store.
In fact, the antiques industry had already emerged at this time, but in the small county of Aoki, it is estimated that not many people had it.
Su Rui was able to discover this stall because she saw the entire stall glowing with purple light. There was probably some treasure there, so she definitely wanted to go and have a look.
When the vendor saw that it was just a little girl, he said impatiently, "Let's go and play. This is not a place to buy toys. Don't disturb my business."
The vendor Su Rui found had been here for several days, but despite asking too many questions, there was nothing left to buy. At this time, I saw a little girl coming over and decided that she wouldn't buy it, so I was very rude.
Su Rui ignored the vendor and squatted down. Having been a little far away just now, Su Rui now discovered that there was only one dark box in the entire stall that glowed with rich purple light, and there were two jade pendants that also glowed with purple light, but they were far behind compared to the boxes. Su Rui secretly exercised her power, and the purple-gold gas went up from the tattoo on her left chest to Su Rui's eyes. Su Rui immediately saw the history of the box. It turned out that the real treasure was not the wooden box. There was a hidden compartment in the wooden box. Hidden in the hidden compartment were four of the nine luminous pearls on the phoenix crown of the Empress Dowager Cixi.
When foreigners invaded the capital, Empress Dowager Cixi did not allow the people to fight back against the invaders. Instead, she took four phoenix crowns and gave them to the foreigners, begging them to withdraw from the capital. But Li Lianying, the eunuch at the time, was not around, so she sent a palace maid to take the night pearl to Ximen Hotel and hand it over to Li Lianying's people. However, she did not expect that the palace maid did not deliver the night pearl to Li Lianying, but ran away with the night pearl. The palace maid hid the Night Pearl in a secret compartment of a wooden box, took the wooden box with her and fled to the Western Province, where she settled down. Then she married a widower with the help of a matchmaker and gave birth to a son for him. Until her death, the wooden box came into the hands of her son. However, her son didn't know there was a treasure in the box, so he bought it to a hawker like a scrap.
Su Rui was so happy when she saw this piece of history. The Night Pearl is a priceless treasure, not to mention there are four in it.
However, Su Rui didn't show anything on her face. Instead, she was picking at the stall. Then she pointed at a jade pendant with a weak purple light and asked the vendor, "Brother, how do you sell this?" She winked and looked cute without spending any money.
When the hawker saw that there was business coming to his door, he immediately smiled and his expression changed really quickly.
"Hey, little sister, you have such good eyesight. I got this from a wealthy family in the countryside of Xi'an. It is a treasure passed down from their ancestors. Their ancestors had two high-ranking officials, and this was worn by the prefect. If you like it, I will give you a solid price, how about three thousand. This is something from the Ming Dynasty. With three thousand, I can just make some errand money."
"MingFrom North Korea? Brother, please don’t lie to me. I just think the meaning is very good, so I will make you a marquis immediately. "Su Rui said innocently.
Su Rui did not put down the jade pendant, but picked up the heart-shaped jade pendant next to it.
"I want these two jade pendants. Brother, please give me a price. "
"You can't lie to me just because I'm young, or I'll let someone beat you. "Su Rui winked at her.
For some reason, the vendor felt a little cold looking at Su Rui with an innocent expression. It must be an illusion, it must be. After comforting himself, the vendor spoke.
"Since you really want it, little sister, just give me five thousand yuan for two jade pendants. I think we are quite destined. "
"Five thousand yuan is a bit expensive, and I don't know if these two are real. Sell ​​them both to me for a thousand dollars. "
Upon hearing that Su Rui had paid so much, the vendor quickly spoke.
"One thousand is not enough, at least this is the number. "The vendor held out four fingers.
Su Rui played with the jade pendant calmly.
“Then it’s one thousand and five, no more, otherwise my mother will scold me. "
"One thousand and fifty is not enough for the price I paid when I collected it. How about you add more, two thousand, and I will treat it as a friend. "The vendor gritted his teeth and looked like I was bleeding profusely.
"Two thousand is just two thousand, but you can give me this box as a gift. My grandma used to have a box like this, but it was broken, so I just gave it to her. "Su Rui looked at the vendor with a smile.
"Okay, no problem. "
Seeing that the box was not valuable, the vendor pretended to be heartbroken and agreed.
But he was snickering in his heart, who was this prodigal kid? He only paid a few dozen yuan for these two jade pendants, and he made more than a thousand yuan in one go. I was thinking in my heart, if there were a few more ignorant children like this, he would get mad.
But Su Rui doesn't have that much money. She could only ask the hawker to follow her to a public telephone booth to make a call, and let Du Yan give her money. Who knows that he is her master's secretary?
Soon, Du Yan came and handed the two thousand yuan that Su Rui had asked to bring to the vendor. Su Rui picked up the box.
"Take those two jade pendants. "After leaving a word, Su Rui took the lead and walked towards the car.
Du Yan held two jade pendants in his hands, while Su Rui held the wooden box in her arms as if holding a porcelain doll.
Du Yan looked at Su Rui's cautious look and understood immediately. It seemed that this box was what Su Rui wanted. The two jade pendants were just a cover, but he didn't see anything special about the box.
When the vendor saw a man driving a small sleeper and wearing a suit bending over Su Rui and calling her "Miss", he really regretted not asking for more money. But he couldn't regret it, why? Didn't you see that the driver in the car was fat and round? I could only take the two thousand yuan and leave in pain.
Su Rui didn't let Du Yan send her to the courtyard, but only asked him to drop her at the entrance of the village.
"I'll give you those two jade pendants. "After that, Su Rui got out of the car with the box in her arms.
On her way back to the courtyard, Su Rui happened to meet Aunt Li and Uncle Li who were returning home from farm work. Uncle Li Cheng's grandfather and Li Fu's grandfather are brothers. They are not brothers in the fifth server. However, Li Fu is selfish and greedy, and Wang Chunhua is a shrew who likes to take advantage of everything. Li Cheng, who is upright, naturally dislikes them. Second Aunt Li is quite straightforward, and Su Rui's mother is the Chinese teacher of her second son, so she is usually close to Su Rui's family.
When she saw Su Rui, she immediately thought of her deceased parents, with pity in her eyes. I sighed in my heart, fortunately I am fourteen years old. What if I was younger? I heard that I was adopted by the old man in the back mountain, but I must have been living under someone else's roof. How could I be as good as my own parents? But it's finally better than Li Fu's family. Don't think that no one knows about Li Fu's good plan, even an orphan whose parents died is not included.He deserved to go to jail. The more I thought about it, the more pitiful I felt for Su Rui. Aunt Li put down the farm tools and said.
"Rui Rui, now that your parents are gone, we can't be of much help. We can only help with some work. When your parents are buried, if anything happens, just come and let them know. Your second uncle and I will go and help."
Li Cheng hesitated for a moment and then said, "When I came home today at noon, I saw Wang Chunhua wandering in front of your house. You said your house is quite remote. Why is she going there? You'd better pay attention. Don't miss anything without knowing it. It's not honest for you to say that even the head of her family has gone in..."
Su Rui's face softened when she saw the sincerity in their eyes.
"Second aunt, don't worry about me. I was adopted by my master and now live in his house. There is nothing important in the house anymore. My parents' belongings have been taken away by me. There are only some daily necessities there."
Su Rui paused and looked east.
"I don't plan to bury my parents here. They have been away from home for too long and it's time to go back."
Aunt Li was surprised to hear what she said, but she thought it was reasonable. After all, their hometown was not here. But doesn’t it mean that both of them have lost their memory? But she didn't ask. Instead he smiled.
"Since you've made your plans, forget it. But if you have any help, just ask Auntie. We will definitely help if we can."
"Thank you first, Auntie Second."
Saying goodbye to Aunt Li and the others, Su Rui watched the sunset quietly for a while. Tell myself silently in my heart that I have been reborn and will not make the same mistakes again. I must pay for those who owe me with my own hands!
With the setting sun and the smoke curling up, Su Rui returned to the courtyard briskly, not yet cooking for the master.
